Our Refund Policy

We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

To start a return, you can contact us at sideshowproductionstattoo@gmail.com.

If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label, as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

You can always contact us for any return question at sideshowproductionstattoo@gmail.com.

Damages and issues
Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged or if you receive the wrong item, so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

Exceptions / non-returnable items
Certain types of items cannot be returned, like perishable goods (such as food, flowers, or plants), custom products (such as special orders or personalized items), and personal care goods (such as beauty products). We also do not accept returns for hazardous materials, flammable liquids, or gases. Please get in touch if you have questions or concerns about your specific item.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards.

Exchanges
The fastest way to ensure you get what you want is to return the item you have, and once the return is accepted, make a separate purchase for the new item.

European Union 14 day cooling off period
Notwithstanding the above, if the merchandise is being shipped into the European Union, you have the right to cancel or return your order within 14 days, for any reason and without a justification. As above, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

Refunds
We will notify you once we’ve received and inspected your return, and let you know if the refund was approved or not. If approved, you’ll be automatically refunded on your original payment method within 10 business days. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process and post the refund too.
If more than 15 business days have passed since we’ve approved your return, please contact us at sideshowproductionstattoo@gmail.com.

content.rendered:
Our Operations Policy

Welcome to Sideshow Productions! We’re committed to providing a safe, hygienic, and professional environment for all our services. To ensure the best experience for everyone, we kindly ask our clients to adhere to the following policies:

 


Consent and Identification

  • Consent Forms: All clients receiving services must sign a consent form acknowledging understanding and agreement to the procedures.

  • Valid ID Requirement: Every client must present a valid government-issued ID. This is crucial for age verification and record-keeping.

Policies for Minors (General Studio Access)

  • Studio Access: Minors are only allowed in the studio for piercing-related services and must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian at all times.

  • Documentation for Minors (Piercings): Minors must bring their birth certificate and a photo ID (valid passport, driver’s license, or school ID). The birth certificate is mandatory.

  • Parent/Guardian ID: Parents or legal guardians must also provide a valid government-issued ID.

Tattoo Services (18+ Everyday)

  • Age Restriction (Standard): We do not provide tattoo services to individuals under the age of 18 for regular, day-to-day appointments.

  • Exception: See “Tattoo Services for Minors (16–17) — Promotional Events Only” below.

Tattoo Services for Minors (16–17) — Promotional Events Only

To participate, all of the following requirements must be met without exception:

  1. Required Documents (Minor):

    • Birth certificate of the child/minor.

    • Driver’s license; if none, a school ID may be used. (A clear photo/screenshot of the ID is acceptable.)

  2. Required Forms (Parents/Guardians):

    • Both parents or legal guardians must complete and sign a Consent to Tattoo form.

    • Provide a copy of both parents’/guardians’ IDs.

  3. School Portfolio Check:

    • A parent or legal guardian will be asked to pull up the child’s school website portfolio; a photo or screenshot will be requested for our records.

  4. Guardian Presence:

    • A parent or legal guardian must remain present for the entire duration (including any waiting period).

    • If the parent/guardian leaves for any reason, the tattoo service will stop immediately and the child will need to wait until the next promotion to begin or finish the tattoo.

  5. Placement Limits:

    • Arms and legs only.

  6. When Available:

    • Tattoos for minors (ages 16–17) are only available during flash promotions, special events, or fundraisers.

    • Promotional designs only; everyday custom bookings for minors are not offered.

  7. Scheduling & Capacity:

    • Availability is limited and may be first-come, first-served during events. Artist approval is required.

  8. Touch-Ups for Promotional Minor Tattoos:

    • Touch-ups follow our standard touch-up policy (see below) unless otherwise specified by the artist at the event.

Touch-Up Policy

  • Initial Touch-Ups: Touch-ups on tattoos are free within the first 30 days of the original tattoo.

  • Additional Touch-Ups: Any further touch-ups are at the artist’s discretion and may incur additional charges.

Right to Refuse Service

Sideshow Productions reserves the right to refuse service to anyone for any reason. This may include, but is not limited to, client behavior, health conditions, or if the requested service violates our professional standards or ethical guidelines.

Sales Policy

  • All Sales Final: Please be advised that all sales are final. We ensure the highest quality in our work and products, and we stand by our services.

Safety and Hygiene

Our studio adheres to strict hygiene and safety protocols. We use 100% disposable, sterilized tubes, needles, and pigments for each client to ensure your safety and peace of mind.

We appreciate your cooperation and understanding of our policies. These guidelines are in place to ensure the safety, comfort, and satisfaction of all our clients. If you have any questions or need clarification on any of our policies, please reach out to us at Sideshow Productions.

Caring for Your Ink

Welcome to our After Care guide! Proper care ensures your tattoos and piercings heal beautifully. Explore our tips for making your new art last while keeping skin healthy and vibrant.

Essential Tattoo Aftercare Tips

Taking care of your new tattoo is crucial for its vibrant look and longevity. Here’s a simple guide to help you nurture your ink and keep it looking its best. Check out the steps below to ensure your body art stays stunning!

After Care Instructions

Remember, proper aftercare is key to the longevity and appearance of your tattoo. For any additional advice or concerns, feel free to reach out to us at Sideshow Productions!

Immediate Aftercare for Piercings:

  • Cleaning Routine: Spray NeilMed Wound Wash directly onto the piercing twice daily for the first 4 weeks. This keeps the area clean and aids in healing.

  • Handling the Jewelry: Do not twist or move the jewelry. Movement can irritate the piercing and disrupt healing.

  • Discharge Management: If discharge doesn’t rinse off with the spray, gently clean it with a cotton swab or gauze moistened with Wound Wash.

Immediate Aftercare for Tattoos:

  • Moisturizing: Apply a small amount of fragrance-free, color-free lotion (Redemption) to the tattoo. Massage it gently into the skin 3-5 times a day or when the skin feels tight.

  • Clothing: Wear appropriate clothing to protect your tattoo, especially in work environments with grease, oil, or metal dust.

  • Healing Phase: Expect a layer of dry skin to form over the tattoo that matches its color. Let it flake off naturally; avoid peeling.

  • Post-Healing: After the dry skin has flaked off, the new skin underneath will adjust. Continue using a fragrance-free lotion.

During Healing for Piercings:

  • Normal Reactions: Expect some bleeding, swelling, tenderness, or bruising initially. As healing progresses, there may be discoloration, itching, and a whitish-yellow fluid that crusts over the jewelry.

  • Careful Sleeping: Avoid sleeping on the piercing to prevent pressure and trauma.

During Healing for Tattoos:

  • Common Reactions: Redness, swelling, and tenderness are normal but should subside within a few days.

  • Healing Phase: You may notice a layer of dry skin over the tattoo that matches its color. Do not peel it off—let it flake off naturally.

Common Questions

Got questions about aftercare? We’ve got answers!
How long does healing take?

The healing time can vary based on the type of work done and your body’s response. Generally, for tattoos, it can take about 2-4 weeks for the outer layer of skin to heal, while piercings often heal within 6-8 weeks. Remember, everyone’s body and healing processes are unique!

What should I avoid during healing?

It’s best to avoid swimming, excessive sweating, and tight clothing during the healing process. Also, steer clear of abrasive products and direct sunlight on the area to prevent irritation.

How do I clean my new tattoo/piercing?

To maintain the integrity and promote healing of your new tattoo or piercing, utilize our recommended products. For optimal recovery, we advise applying our piercing spray 2-3 times daily for a duration of 4-6 weeks. Please refrain from using ointments.

Can I use sunscreen on my tattoo?

Once your tattoo is fully healed, applying sunscreen is a great way to protect it. Just make sure to wait until the healing period is over before introducing any new products!

What should I do if it gets infected?

Reach out to our staff or the shop and we will have you in our hearts to take care of you as we did the service. All of our utensils are disposable and single use, based on health department standards, so it’s 99.99% certain you cannot get an infection from us.

Your Questions, Answered

Explore our frequently asked questions to learn about flash tattoos.
What is a flash tattoo?

A flash tattoo is a pre-designed tattoo that’s ready to go — usually part of a curated sheet of designs. Clients choose from these designs instead of creating a custom piece from scratch.

 

Do I need an appointment for a flash tattoo?

Yes! While we do offer walk-ins, booking an appointment ensures your design choice and preferred time are reserved.

Can I modify a flash design?

Minor adjustments like size or small placement tweaks are usually possible, but large alterations may require a custom tattoo booking instead.

How much do flash tattoos cost?

Prices vary by size, placement, and artist. Flash tattoos may have set prices, but your artist will confirm the final cost before starting.

Do you offer flash events or special flash sheets?

Yes! We regularly host themed flash days and artist-curated flash sheets. Follow us on social media to stay updated on upcoming events.

What should I do to prepare for my flash tattoo?

  • Get a good night’s sleep

  • Eat before your appointment

  • Stay hydrated

  • Avoid alcohol or blood thinners 24 hours before your appointment
